scope: One deterministic full-run sample: all 233 accepted rows are single-expansion, so no multi bucket exists. Not an all-row semantic guarantee or final release approval.

reviewed_examples.evidence: The primary Chingford Study abstract describes 594 women followed across 14 years; greater BMI and BMI change predict later knee pain, with BMI-change association independent of radiographic OA. The concise yes answer matches the task and supplied results without adding unsupported clinical guidance. Unrelated appended abstracts are not used.

trajectory_checks: Read task/reference, saved system and native expand schema/call, the complete tool observation and final answer. The source-wide audit separately checked every accepted task against the official train IDs and validated memory/labels. This is source-text grounding review, not medical advice or an independent evaluation of the study.
